svg.title: 3. Paste into Illustrator’s extensions folder
svg.desc: Paste this path into the File Explorer address bar and press Enter: C:\Program Files\Adobe\Adobe Illustrator 2026\ Support Files\Required\CEP\extensions Paste (Ctrl + V). Approve Windows administrator access if asked.
